queries.sql:
SELECT w.webhook_id, w.event_type, w.target_url, w.is_active, w.last_triggered, w.failure_count, w.created_by,
              (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_WEBHOOK_DELIVERY d WHERE d.webhook_id = w.webhook_id) AS delivery_count,
              (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_WEBHOOK_DELIVERY d WHERE d.webhook_id = w.webhook_id AND d.is_success = TRUE) AS success_count
       FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_WEBHOOK w ORDER BY w.event_type, w.created_at
